XVideos API

v2.5.3

Search Videos search()

async
Searches for videos and yields results as an async generator.
async for result in client.search( query: str, sorting_sort: str | Sort = Sort.Sort_relevance, pages: int | str = 2 ) -> AsyncGenerator[ScrapeResult[Video], None]

Parameters

  • query str — Search terms
  • pages int | "all" — Number of pages

Returns

→ AsyncGenerator[ScrapeResult[Video], None]

Download Video download()

async
Downloads the video using the HLS downloader.
await video.download( configuration: DownloadConfigHLS ) -> bool | DownloadReport

Parameters

  • configuration DownloadConfigHLS — Download settings

Returns

→ bool | DownloadReport

Get Channel Videos videos()

async
Iterates over the channel's uploaded videos. Set pages=0 to fetch all pages.
async for result in channel.videos( pages: int = 0 ) -> AsyncGenerator[ScrapeResult[Video], None]

Parameters

  • pages int — Maximum pages; 0 uses all profile pages.

Returns

→ AsyncGenerator[ScrapeResult[Video], None]

Get Performer Videos videos()

async
Iterates over the performer's uploaded videos.
async for result in pornstar.videos( pages: int = 0 ) -> AsyncGenerator[ScrapeResult[Video], None]

Parameters

  • pages int — Maximum pages

Returns

→ AsyncGenerator[ScrapeResult[Video], None]
